evals.prompt: Find my favorited Karakeep bookmarks about kubernetes from 2025, read the full text of the top match, and tag it with self-hosted environment.
evals.expected_output: Calls search-bookmarks with qualifiers (e.g. kubernetes is:fav after:2025-01-01 before:2025-12-31), then calls get-bookmark-content to fetch the Markdown body, then calls attach-tag-to-bookmark with tagsToAttach: ["self-hosted environment"].
assertions: Uses search-bookmarks with appropriate qualifiers (is:fav, date bounds)
Calls get-bookmark-content rather than assuming search-bookmarks returns full content
Uses attach-tag-to-bookmark passing tag name in tagsToAttach (not a tagId)

evals.prompt: If I call delete-list on a parent list in Karakeep, what happens to its child lists and bookmarks, and how do I clear a bookmark's summary without changing its note?
evals.expected_output: Explains delete-list keeps bookmarks and promotes child lists to root level (parentId: null) unless re-parented first, and update-bookmark accepts summary: null while leaving omitted fields like note unchanged.
assertions: States delete-list preserves bookmarks and sets child lists' parentId to null (root level)
States update-bookmark accepts summary: null to clear it and leaves omitted fields unchanged

evals.prompt: Run a semantic search in Karakeep sorted by creation date asc.
evals.expected_output: Notes that searchMode: semantic (and hybrid) only support sortOrder: relevance, so sortOrder: asc requires searchMode: fts (or omitting semantic/hybrid).
assertions: Identifies that semantic and hybrid search modes only support relevance sorting
Recommends sortOrder: relevance for semantic search or searchMode: fts for asc date sorting
